name: Chin Kyuu
source:
A strategist of the Tou army. A self-proclaimed partner and advisor of [url=/c19321]Ryo Fu[/url], and considers herself Ryo Fu's protector, dishing out punishment to anyone doing anything she considers offensive to Ryo Fu (like she did to [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] when he bought Ryo Fu a bagful of nikuman in public, resulting in one of Ryo Fu's attention-getting eating escapades).

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters#Chinky.C5.AB]Wikipedia[/url]]
